articles.title: Somali Cabinet Approves National Port Security Modernization Initiative
articles.title_so: Golaha Wasiirada Soomaaliya Oo Anshixiyay Qorshaha Casriyeinta Amniga Dekadaha
articles.summary: The federal cabinet has endorsed a new security and infrastructure strategy across maritime ports to bolster international trade and regional connectivity.
articles.summary_so: Golaha wasiirada ayaa ansixiyay qorshe cusub oo lagu ilaalinayo amnigiyada iyo kaabayaasha dekadaha Soomaaliya si loo horumariyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah.
articles.content: MOGADISHU — Somalia's Council of Ministers has formally approved a national port security modernization plan aimed at expanding trade facilities across the Mogadishu Port and coastal regions. Senior officials highlighted the collaboration with regional partners to streamline Customs operations and ensure safe maritime logistics.
articles.content_so: MOGADISHU — Golaha Wasiirada Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah u ansixiyay qorshaha casriyeinta amniga dekadaha waxaana la filayaa inuu kordhiyo fursadaha ganacsiga. Wasiirada ayaa xusay in tallaabadan ay sare u qaadi doonto xiriirka ganacsi ee gobolka.

articles.title: Horn of Africa Diplomatic Forum Addresses Regional Security and Trade Partnerships
articles.title_so: Shirka D dibomaasiyadeed ee Geeska Afrika Oo Laguga Hadlay Amniga iyo Ganacsiga
articles.summary: Regional envoys gathered in Addis Ababa to discuss ongoing bilateral trade pacts and peace initiatives across the Horn of Africa.
articles.summary_so: Wakiillada gobolka oo ku kulmay Addis Ababa ayaa ka wada hadlay heshiisyada ganacsiga iyo dadaallada nabadroolinta Geeska Afrika.
articles.content: ADDIS ABABA — Representatives from Eastern African nations met today to discuss infrastructure integration, joint trade initiatives, and regional conflict prevention strategies. The summit focused on bolstering cooperation between neighboring nations to enhance economic resiliency.
articles.content_so: ADDIS ABABA — Wakiillada waddamada Bariga Afrika ayaa maanta ku kulmay magaala-madaxda Itoobiya si ay uga wada hadlaan isku-xirka kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha iyo nabadda gobolka.

articles.title: Champions League Quarterfinals Heat Up as European Giants Secure Victories
articles.title_so: Ciyaaraha Horyaallada Yurub Oo Maraya Meel Xasaasi Ah
articles.summary: Top clubs in Premier League, La Liga, and Serie A gear up for critical weekend fixtures following exciting mid-week European matches.
articles.summary_so: Kooxaha ugu waaweyn Premier League, La Liga iyo Serie A ayaa u preparesgaroobaya ciyaaraha todobaadka iyadoo tartanku aad u kululaaday.
articles.content: LONDON — The European football calendar reaches a critical stage with Premier League leaders locking horns with title rivals, while La Liga and Serie A giants prepare for high-stakes matches. Fans are anticipating thrilling action across all major European leagues.
articles.content_so: LONDON — Tartanka ciyaaraha kubadda cagta ee Yurub ayaa maraya meel aad u xiiso badan, iyadoo kooxaha ugu waaweyn ay u tartamayaan horyaallada Ingiriiska, Spain iyo Italy.
